question: ip-proxy/webshare-static-residential carries the Webshare free plan in free_tier.stated and limits[1] (1 GB per month on the free plan), but the free plan is a datacenter offer whose proxies 'are not included in any of our paid plans' and now has its own record, ip-proxy/webshare-free-plan. Should the static record's free_tier become 'none for this product' with a pointer to the new record, and limits[1] be dropped?
why: The Static Residential (ISP) product has no free tier of its own; the store parses the static record as having a 1 GB free quota, which credits a residential product with a datacenter allowance. The record is outside this unit's scope.
